addressed_concerns.concern: The narrower implementation-PIT concern around factor construction/timestamping was substantially addressed: the judge cited sig_date-bounded windows in compute_liquidity.R, in-DB -|AC1| construction, and load_month_factors() plus Z_Score_Aligned compliance, reducing the chance that the raw AC1 signal itself is built with future-month data.

unresolved.point: Mechanism-sign mismatch remains intact: the cited liquidity papers support illiquidity premia or market-level serial correlation, not the cross-sectional claim that lower |AC1| should earn positive alpha. S1 needs a sign-consistent mechanism and orthogonal IC versus Amihud ILLIQ, turnover, and short-term reversal.

|AC1| remains economically underidentified. S1 must decompose exposures versus size, beta, volatility, turnover, Amihud illiquidity, and reversal to determine whether L22 is just a liquid low-vol/mega-cap descriptor rather than a distinct alpha source.

The STR_1636/L-137 crash lineage is still unresolved. Removing Piotroski is not evidence that left-tail concentration disappears; S1 needs crisis-period drawdown clustering, post-cost turnover, and hard-stop review if MDD exceeds 45% or turnover exceeds 600%.

Selection PIT remains a live governance issue because recent_3y_icir appears to have informed 'why now'. The smoke result can validate pipeline behavior, but it cannot be treated as clean ex-ante alpha evidence without recording that limitation.

Low correlation to C19 and momentum does not settle redundancy against liquidity and reversal families. S1 still needs persistence checks after stricter liquidity screens and after 15 bps turnover drag.

strongest_opposing_argument: The judge and quant make the strongest case against REVISE: this is a deliberately bounded smoke run on an existing PIT-safe Factor DB signal with low correlation to core/momentum sleeves, so conditional progression to S1 may be justified even before the full causal mechanism is proven.
kill_scenarios_update: New risks surfaced in debate: sign-semantics drift, where low |AC1| is incorrectly interpreted as strong mean reversion and the sleeve ends up owning bland liquid low-vol names instead of a true reversal effect; and selection-PIT contamination if recent_3y_icir influenced admission, making forward expectations materially overstated.
